_about: Pausanias, Description of Greece, translator per title. A. R. Shilleto (Bohn, 1886), 2 vols., clean Gutenberg. The 1824 second edition of the Taylor translation, vols. 1-3 (vol. 3 added 2026-10-02), raw IA OCR: the title page reads only 'translated from the Greek'; the attribution to Thomas Taylor is the library catalogue's. Margaret Verrall's translation of the Attica in Mythology and Monuments of Ancient Athens (1890, with Jane Harrison's commentary), raw IA OCR. Added 2026-10-03 (later): J. G. Frazer's translation, vol. I of his six-volume Pausanias (Macmillan, 1898; the other five volumes are commentary, indices and maps, not wanted here), raw IA OCR of a Digital Library of India scan from the Asiatic Society of Bombay copy (text file 91327_djvu.txt), clean 0.92. Frazer died 1941. Round dx (2026-10-23) completed Frazer's Pausanias (1898): vols II-VI, the commentary, indices and maps, raw IA OCR with each title page read; Greek-dense in places, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling.
